system_prompt:
Use web search to find tomorrow’s weather forecast for the cities below. Determine tomorrow’s calendar date using web search and return it as forecast_date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Return only a JSON object with forecast_date, summary, and forecasts. Each forecast must include city, low_c, high_c, conditions, and sources (objects with title and URL in the url field). Use the city names below in order, Celsius, and real forecast sources. Sources must be public HTTP(S) page URLs, never internal search or weather reference IDs. Never invent data.
Report on these cities, in this order:
- Budapest, Hungary
- Vienna, Austria
- Prague, Czechia
- Warsaw, Poland
- Berlin, Germany
- Paris, France
- London, United Kingdom
- Dublin, Ireland
- Madrid, Spain
- Rome, Italy
- Athens, Greece
- Istanbul, Türkiye
- Cairo, Egypt
- Cape Town, South Africa
- Nairobi, Kenya
- New York, USA
- Toronto, Canada
- Tokyo, Japan
- Singapore, Singapore
- Sydney, Australia
